tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to store and retrieve problems from the database.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Library Database
tasks.description: Design and create the database schema for storing problem details.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user profiles and their progress.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data and profile information.

tasks.name: Set Up Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Explanations UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Explanations Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation work correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles display and update correctly.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard updates and displays correctly.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Explanations
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and explanations are displayed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem retrieval, creation, and updates.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an intuitive UI for users to write, test, and submit code solutions.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a backend system to compile, execute, and evaluate code submissions securely.
T5.notes: Use sandboxing to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user stats, achievements, and activity history.
T6.notes: Incorporate customization options for user profiles.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, authentication, and profile updates.
T7.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users with sorting and filtering options.
T8.notes: Include real-time updates for dynamic rankings.

T9.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings based on user performance.
T9.notes: Optimize for frequent updates and large user bases.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a UI to display hints and explanations for problems in an accessible format.
T10.notes: Allow toggling hints to avoid spoilers.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage and serve hints and explanations for problems.
T11.notes: Ensure proper versioning for content updates.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of problem library features, including search and filtering.
T12.notes: Test with a variety of problem datasets.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy, security, and performance.
T13.notes: Include edge cases and stress testing.

T14.implementation_approach: Verify user profile functionality, including data updates and display accuracy.
T14.notes: Test with different user roles and permissions.

T15.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard updates and ensure correct ranking calculations.
T15.notes: Simulate high traffic scenarios for performance testing.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate the functionality and accessibility of hints and explanations.
T16.notes: Ensure content is displayed correctly across devices.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud environment with proper CI/CD pipelines.
T17.notes: Monitor performance and address post-deployment issues promptly.
